import time
import unittest


class Bad(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_sleeps_then_checks(self):
        start()
        time.sleep(0.4)
        self.assertTrue(done())

    def test_bounds_a_time(self):
        t = time.monotonic()
        step()
        self.assertLess(time.monotonic() - t, 0.5)

    def test_allowed(self):
        while not done():
            time.sleep(0.1)  # a poll
        time.sleep(0.1)  # timing: only orders two writes in the file's mtime

        def slow():
            time.sleep(1)  # a fake that acts slow
        t = time.monotonic()
        self.assertLess(time.monotonic() - t, timing.limit(1))
